criteria.criterion: Given a user favourites a Beacon, then the Beacon appears in favourite Beacons.
observations: The Beacons layer was added and the Beacons panel loaded Beacon cards.
A visible Beacon card changed from Add to favourites to Remove from favourites after selection.
The Favourites tab count changed from Favourites (0) to Favourites (1).
The Favourites view displayed the same Beacon card after switching to the Favourites tab.

criteria.criterion: Given a user unfavourites a Beacon, then the Beacon no longer appears in favourite Beacons.
observations: The visible favourite Beacon card had a Remove from favourites control in the Favourites view before removal.
After removal, the Favourites tab count changed to Favourites (0).
The Favourites view no longer displayed the Beacon card and showed the empty-state message for no favourite Beacons.

evidenceLimitations: Live browser screenshots were captured during the run, but PNG files could not be persisted to the repository from this execution environment.
Committed evidence is redacted to avoid exposing internal Beacon identifiers or authenticated application details.
